title: Planner: Sprints and backlogs in unified plans
description: Sprints and backlogs in unified plans let users organize and prioritize work in a product backlog, plan time-boxed sprints, and focus on the current sprint. Sprint planning stays separate from buckets, so teams can continue using buckets to organize work.
